verdict.rationale: The evidence shows general task automation ('automating repetitive, mundane tasks'), sales sequences, and an async 'Job Status' API endpoint. None of these documents the ability to set up a recurring, time-based schedule for jobs or workflows. Automating repetitive tasks and tracking one-off bulk job status are adjacent features, not a recurring scheduler.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
